title: Beginner: AI assistant to governed agent
summary: Learn how AI applications work, then build and assess a first governed agent without writing code or YAML.
outcomes: Configure identity, capability, zone, approval, and enforcement
completion_criteria: Complete all 18 modules, pass every assessment, and finish a valid visual-to-.nyx round trip.

title: Developer: building governed AI software
summary: Build, test, observe, integrate, and deliver cooperatively governed AI applications.
outcomes: Test allow, deny, failure, and bypass
completion_criteria: Complete all modules, run real adapter allow and deny paths, and pass the Forge delivery challenge.

title: Agent engineer: tools, workflows, and multi-agent systems
audience: Engineers building agents with CrewAI, LangGraph, or custom runtimes
summary: Govern tools, loops, retries, memory, handoffs, framework surfaces, and multi-agent authority.
prerequisites: API or programming familiarity, or complete the foundation modules
outcomes: Preserve authority across delegation and handoff
completion_criteria: Complete all modules plus CrewAI, LangGraph, and multi-agent separation-of-duties scenario suites.

title: Architect: trust zones, authority, and runtime boundaries
audience: Solution, security, enterprise, and platform architects
summary: Design identities, capabilities, trust zones, delegation, composition, PEP placement, and assurance boundaries.
outcomes: Choose enforcement by consequence and adversary
completion_criteria: Complete all modules and classify every effect path as wrapped, unsupported, unwrapped, or independently enforced.

title: Governance and risk: policy, evidence, assurance, and audit
audience: Governance, risk, compliance, audit, and security teams
summary: Evaluate policy, approvals, accountability, evidence, threats, standards mappings, and residual risk with progressive technical detail.
completion_criteria: Complete all modules and produce a valid claim register and audit package with no critical tier or compliance errors.

title: Nornyx practitioner: contracts to runtime evidence
audience: Nornyx adopters, maintainers, and advanced engineers
summary: Author and check `.nyx`, generate and lock controls, load an Authorizer, integrate adapters, validate evidence, and gate delivery.
prerequisites: Agentic and governance literacy, or pass the foundation readiness check
completion_criteria: Complete all route modules, pass Labs 14–24 executable gates, and pass the capstone review.

title: Complete curriculum: beginner to professional
audience: Learners seeking the full academy sequence
summary: Complete all AI engineering, agentic systems, governance, Nornyx, integration, risk, and audit modules.
outcomes: Build and assess governed AI systems
Inspect real Nornyx controls and evidence
Defend precise assurance and residual-risk claims
completion_criteria: Complete all 31 modules with no waivers and achieve at least 85% on the capstone review.
